title: Krishok-LeafCareNet: An Integrated IoT–Edge AI System with Hierarchical Classification for Multi-Crop Disease Diagnosis and Real-Time Advisory
description: Official open-source research software release for Krishok-LeafCareNet, an integrated IoT-edge AI system combining hierarchical crop disease recognition, in-situ soil microclimate monitoring via ESP32, and an offline-first intelligent agricultural advisory mobile application.
